author: Second Wind
description:
Swarms of coin mimics  skitter through vaults, marketplaces, and pockets alike, devouring every piece of gold they can. As paranoia spreads and entire societies teeter on collapse, our heroes reunite with old allies to vanquish the evil that's overtaking the world. Everything is at stake, and they’ll need all the blades, spells, and reckless plans they’ve ever devised to bring this darkness to heel.
